description: List scans that the AI analysis rated high risk, optionally above min_risk_score and min_confidence, each with URL, title and the analysis. min_risk_score is on the AI's 0-10 risk scale (default 7) and min_confidence is a 0-100 percentage (default 70).

min_confidence.description: Minimum AI confidence, as a percentage from 0 to 100.
min_confidence.title: Min Confidence
